name: Utah All-Stars 2026
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUyNzY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--52b589b7024452b0af80173384400764db1a004b/allstars(1).png) # IMPORTANT Utah All-Stars 2026 is a unique competition that has been organized in parallel with Utah Newcomers 2026. Both competitions will happen on the same day in the same venue. All-Stars is an exciting opportunity for the best of Utah to compete against each other. If you are an experienced competitor, even if you don't consider yourself to be the best of the best, we ask that you register for this competition. If you are a first time or less experienced competitor (competed for the first time in 2024, 2025, 2026 or otherwise consider yourself to be less experienced), we strongly encourage you to register for Utah Newcomers, as the scheduling of both competitions has been tailored specifically to improve the expereince for you. The most unique aspect of this competition is how the schedules have been interleaved. For each event, the finals of All-Stars will immediately preceed the first round of the same event of this competition. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Go to our [Website](https://utahcubing.org/) to find upcoming Utah Cubing Association competitions! Here you can also find our Facebook group , Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server.
